tagline: Cycling in everyday life: the right bike, good care and safe routes, clearly explained
description: VELNIXO is a guide for everyone who rides a bike in Germany: choose your bike and e-bike correctly, maintain and repair it yourself, get through town and country safely, plan tours and find the right equipment, thoroughly, independently and without technical jargon.
author: VELNIXO editorial team

kaufberatung.name: Buying advice
kaufberatung.description: Which bike is right for me? Frame size, bike types, buying new or used, budget and test ride, step by step.

wartung-und-reparatur.name: Maintenance & Repair
wartung-und-reparatur.description: Maintain and adjust the chain, brakes, gears, tires and lights yourself, with a tool list and clear boundaries as to when it's the workshop's turn.

e-bike.name: E-bikes & Pedelecs
e-bike.description: Motor, battery, range, charging, care and law relating to Pedelecs and S-Pedelecs, explained honestly and without advertising promises.

sicher-unterwegs.name: Travel safely
sicher-unterwegs.description: Traffic rules, visibility, helmet, theft protection and smart driving in the city, country and in bad weather.

touren-und-reisen.name: Tours & cycling trips
touren-und-reisen.description: Cycle paths and long-distance cycle paths in Germany, plan tours, combine cycle trips with luggage, train and bike.

ausruestung.name: Equipment & everyday life
ausruestung.description: Bags, clothing, child seats and trailers, cargo bikes and everything that makes the bike an everyday vehicle.
